nextPhases.name: Build Mode MVP
nextPhases.goal: Produce a Build Harness MVP that can accept project requirements, auto-select execution mode, generate blueprint and task graph, execute a build, and pass through Diagnostic Gate.
mustInclude: Diagnostic gate integration (Quick Mode wired in)
State file update (state.json created and maintained)
nextPhases.deliverable: A documented, runnable Build Harness that can take any project and produce a working build plan + execute it
nextPhases.estimatedScope: One large phase covering all Build Harness MVP components

nextPhases.name: External Memory MVP
nextPhases.goal: Implement file-based external memory so Codex can continue complex projects across sessions without relying on window conversation memory.
mustInclude: startup check (verify state files exist and are consistent)
nextPhases.deliverable: A file-based external memory system that enables multi-session complex project development
nextPhases.estimatedScope: One large phase covering all state file components + retrieval mechanism
nextPhases.dependsOn: FACTORY-BUILD-1 (needs Build Harness to populate state)

nextPhases.name: Real Complex Project Build Trial
nextPhases.goal: Use the full Build Harness + External Memory to build a real complex project from requirements to delivery, comparing Vanilla vs Build Mode outcomes.
mustInclude: Select a real complex project (not SkillMarket, not a toy)
Baseline: single Codex or Vanilla build attempt
Build Mode run: intake → classify → blueprint → task graph → build → diagnostic → deliver
Continuation/handoff test (new window resumes from state)
Outcome comparison: Vanilla vs Build Mode (metrics TBD)
nextPhases.deliverable: Evidence that Build Harness + External Memory can complete a real complex project
nextPhases.estimatedScope: One large phase — the real trial

phaseDesignPrinciples: Each phase is ONE large-block objective, not a collection of small tasks
No splitting into BUILD-1a, BUILD-1b, etc.
Each phase produces a concrete, verifiable deliverable
Phases build on each other: Harness → Memory → Real Trial
Diagnostic Pack is a gate in each phase, not a separate phase
